specimens.variant: 40 mm steel Luminor Marina Quaranta / white automatic dial / fitted black leather strap and signed pin buckle / closed-back specimen
specimens.evidence: EWC stock 57576 explicitly identifies PAM01271. All six actual gallery photographs inspected, including back and buckle at full resolution. Actual white dial has date at 3 and small seconds at 9; closed brushed steel back marked LUMINOR / PANERAI / STAINLESS STEEL / 100 m with seller-masked identity digits. Source describes automatic P.900, but no movement photograph exists. No neighbouring PAM01372, PAM01272 or short numeric alias inherits these images. Source paper-date fields conflict, so no confirmed production year is asserted.
views: Actual white Luminor Marina dial with date at 3, small seconds at 9 and fitted black leather strap. Compare this white-dial specimen only; source-specified 40 mm cannot be measured from pixels.
Actual closed brushed steel back, LUMINOR / PANERAI / STAINLESS STEEL / 100 m; seller-masked identity digits cannot be compared.
Actual PANERAI-signed steel pin buckle on fitted black leather strap. Factory originality is not asserted.
